coherence: Available total_record_count equals sum equal/earlier/later/missing_observation/no_closed_at record counts.
Each directional race count is<=corresponding record count and<=total_race_count; it is0 iff that record category is0.
uncomparable_race_count<=missing_observation_record_count+no_closed_at_record_count and<=total_race_count; it is0 iff that combined record category is0.
Directional race sets may overlap when multiple model originals for one race retain different cutoffs. Do NOT require race-count sum==total_race_count.
Every race belongs to at least one category: total_race_count<=sum three directional race counts+uncomparable_race_count. Each directional race count<=total_race_count-uncomparable_race_count.
Coherent empty inventory returns available zero counts; mismatch_count>0 is NOT required by this diagnostic projector. It is an inventory, not an admission test.

counting_semantics.direction: Earlier/later means observation.closed_at < or > the original info.race_cutoff_at. Export no times,dates,offsets,elapsed values,min/max or dynamic buckets.
counting_semantics.categories: Missing observation ->missing_observation_record_count. Present observation with missing/None closed_at ->no_closed_at_record_count. Otherwise equal/earlier/later. Each record counts once; race categories are sets. uncomparable races are union of missing/no_closed.
